name: Leaderboard bar race
looks: A ranked list of horizontal bars (avatar, name, bar, dollar value) under a dated header card. As a date ticker advances from one cut to the next, the bars regrow to new lengths and the values roll to new numbers, rows that overtake each other swap position, and a big soft date watermark crossfades behind the card on each step.
build: One flex DOM row per rank: avatar chip, a bar that tweens width/scaleX to its new value, a value span. On each date step, re-sort rows by new value and FLIP-tween each row to its new slot (~0.3s, power2.inOut) while the bar regrows and the digits roll up. The date watermark crossfades behind the card, never in front.
sound: A tick per row that re-sorts, a soft riser under the bars regrowing, a louder tick on the date flip.
prompt: Show a small ranked leaderboard of bars with names and values, under a dated header. Advance the date once or twice, letting the bars regrow, the values roll to new numbers, and rows swap position as they overtake each other, with a soft date watermark behind the card.
source: founder.page's launch film in prompt-motion.com's gallery (prompt-motion.com/ratheejaisal-1f4538), studied 2026-10-09
